memories.name: A Governor No Longer
memories.objective: Infiltrate a party in disguise and assassinate Woodes Rogers.
steps: Sail to Kingston near 619,61.
Talk to a local Assassin to learn where Rogers is.
Go north to a slightly drunk Italian diplomat at 615,169.
Follow him west into a quiet alley, take him down and loot his clothes for a disguise.
Walk north to the manor at 617,171; the disguise eases the guards.
Mingle with the crowd and wait; getting too close early risks recognition.
Track Rogers through the party to a bench in the western grounds.
Assassinate him from the bench when he passes close.
Run, lose the guards and reach anonymity.
Speak with Anto to finish.
optional: Pick up a portrait in the eastern corridor while waiting.
tips: Do not approach Rogers too early.
Guards react immediately after the kill, so flee.
gaps: No sync objectives beyond the portrait.

memories.name: Royal Misfortune
memories.objective: Hunt Roberts: raid a pirate camp, chase his ship the Royal Fortune and beat him in a duel.
steps: Sail to 939,415 and clear the ships guarding the start (needed for full anonymity).
After rescuing a stranded sailor you arrive near Principe; go west onto the island.
Tag pirates with Eagle Vision and plan a route.

Work through the camp: western watchtower gunner, northwest rooftops and trees, tall rock-face structure, bushes to a gunner-guarded building, guards by a haystack, then the northern alarm bell to sabotage.
Dash out of the camp; Roberts flees, so dive and return to the Jackdaw's helm.
Chase the Royal Fortune, staying on its tail and dealing steady damage.
Shoot the powder barrels Roberts throws from the stern before they blow up near you.
Use Mortars or Heated Shot on the hull until boarding is possible.
Board and fight Roberts one on one.
tips: In the duel, wait for his attacks and parry on the blue flash.
Consecutive parries stagger him and open attack windows.
Dodge his heavy attack instead of parrying.
gaps: Number of pirates to tag and hull damage needed to board not given.

memories.name: Tainted Blood
memories.objective: Reach Anne in Havana, assassinate Torres' apparent target and beat his armoured bodyguard El Tiburon.
steps: Sail to Havana near 227,586.
Dock, follow Anne into a cutscene, then climb northwest to the tower top to meet her.
Take the nearby zipline down and assassinate the guard at its end.
Head south over rooftops and kill another guard to the east.
Reach the rooftop behind the target and leap-assassinate when he moves.
Learn the target was a decoy and face El Tiburon.
Use a ranged weapon aimed at his face to stagger him, then a takedown to strip his armour.
Dodge his alternating ranged shots and heavy melee; hit with heavies after his combo.
After depleting his health, go south to the Assassin bureau at 216,569 to finish.
optional: Sync the local Viewpoint if not already done.
tips: Melee does little against his armour.
Use nearby guards as human shields against his ranged attacks.
Loot guards for ammo and remedies; guards keep respawning.
gaps: How to spot the decoy beforehand and the number of guards not given.

memories.name: Ever a Splinter
memories.objective: Return to Long Bay, reach the Observatory, clear its trials and assassinate Torres.
steps: Sail to Long Bay near 488,230.
Gain anonymity against the Spanish fleet blocking the cove, ideally luring it away.
Head southeast toward the Observatory, using branches to pass guards distracted by wildlife.
Follow the torch-lit cave path north, assassinating guard pairs on the beach.
Inside the cave clear the fire guards, watch for a lone patrol and continue south to a hidden chest.
Pass more guard pairs and a waterfall to reach the Observatory entrance.
Wait for the fatal gold barrier to fade, then pass.
In the moving pillar room climb to two alerted guards (one may be spared) and then up the moving wall using the black grip points.
Jump the stone beam to the western platform, which collapses into the final fight.
Clear all guards, roll into a section just before the gold walls surge, and disable three devices (southwest, then a wall with a flashing barrier, then far north).
Drop down and assassinate Torres to end the mission and main story.
optional: Sync the Viewpoint at 492,229 if missed earlier.
tips: Time the barrier flashes; a bad climb is instantly fatal and restarts the fight.
Guards caught in surging walls often die; a sweep attack can push them in.
gaps: Guard numbers and exact jungle checkpoints not given.

notes: Guide-slug URLs 404; used the /rumors/ path. Page 3 of 3, appears complete. Page body says Edward plans to finish the job in England while its FAQ says London. After the ending Edward returns to Great Inagua and learns Rogers survived and fled to England; open world stays available. Fetched through a summarising tool, so wording is secondhand.
